title: Trabajo y conflicto
goal: Read how immigrant political ideas fed labor organizing in Argentina and Chile, Argentina's 1902 deportation law, and the 1907 Santa María School massacre of striking nitrate workers.

items: Explain what political ideas immigrants brought and how workers responded.
State what Argentina's 1902 Ley de Residencia permitted.
Describe what happened at the Escuela Santa María in December 1907.
Explain what happened to the official death toll and memory of the massacre.
Use antes de que and hasta que with the subjunctive, and contrast with cuando + indicative for a completed fact.
